items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: And when it was time for her to sing man, I’d lay back and just listen you know, and it inspired notes for me to play underneath her too

ctx.x: Yeah, she had that church Gospel combination with pig foot and a bottle of beer or something like that.

A pig foot and a bottle of beer! Okay. You know it’s all true, what you said. It is true. She had all of it. Yeah. The church, the pig foot, and the bottle of beer, she had it all. And she could bring it man. She could simply bring it. And she was a sweetheart. I really loved her. And when it was time for her to sing man, I’d lay back and just listen you know, and it inspired notes for me to play underneath her too, you know, the way she did it, it fit that tenor sound. Yeah. And that was wonderful. We did some…
Yeah I give Dr. Vollmer a lot of credit for the audaciousness of sort of what he does in handling the logistics and all of that. There’s a lot of passion there.
